class: engineering (same algorithm, same probes and relations; native arithmetic only)

cuts.sparse: KIC_SPARSE_REDUCE=1: Gf2_128 reduction by constant shifts for tails {0,2,3,4} (n=73) and {0,2,4,7} (n=83) instead of the two carry-less folds (src/cryptanalysis/semaev_decomp.rs); equal to the fold and the byte table on 20,000 random and edge inputs per modulus (unit test)
cuts.algebra: KIC_ROOT_ALGEBRA=1: batched inversion of (l+r)*l*r, quotients recovered by two field squarings: 10 multiplications plus 2 squarings per candidate instead of 11 multiplications; equal roots in the same order on random and exceptional inputs, scalar and batched, n=73 and 83 (unit test)
cuts.factorise: early stop of the u128 trial division once the remainder is a word-size prime (koblitz_index_calculus.rs::factorise_u128); same factor list as the old trial division (unit test incl. the n=73 order)
cuts.dropped_before_freeze: single to_normal per candidate through linearity: to_normal(first^q) needs to_normal(q), so the apply count is unchanged; basis-aware solve not attempted

pilot_excluded_from_data: unfrozen single and double runs during development (scan ns per probe 216-294, noisy; one callgrind pass at K=40, 2000 states: collected Ir ctl 2634M, sparse 2608M, algebra 2721M, all 2693M; reduce_fold Ir ctl 427M, sparse 511M). They are disclosed, not data. Both switches default OFF in the shipped binary on the strength of the Ir pilot; arms below set them explicitly.

host: same 4 vCPU Xeon 2.80 GHz KVM guest as T20; cores 1-3 (scan) and core 1 (process start, callgrind) through tools/isolated_bench.py

stage_A_scan.what: ns per probe of the 20,000-state scan at the real K=600 base (KIC_PROF_MAX_STATES=20000, KIC_INDEX_THREADS=3 KIC_INDEX_BATCH_INV=1), same new binary, switches set explicitly
stage_A_scan.design: 7 rounds, arm order rotated by one per round (5 arms), pairing by round
stage_A_scan.statistic: ratio of medians arm/ctl over rounds; 95% percentile bootstrap over rounds (10,000)
stage_A_scan.kill: a cut (and all) clears only if median ratio <= 1/1.2 = 0.8333 AND the bootstrap upper bound <= 0.90; otherwise it is recorded as not reaching 1.2x on the scan and not carried to end to end
stage_A_scan.validity: probes and hits identical in every run; A/A ctl2 CI contains 1

stage_P_process_start.what: wall of one process start (construct:73:1:40, exit after one scanned state, single core), old binary vs new binary, 5 rounds alternating, paired by round; measures the factorise cut
stage_P_process_start.no_kill: reported only; it is outside the rank stage and about 0.2% of the n=73 K=600 row

stage_C_instruction_counts: callgrind collected Ir at K=40, 2000 states, ctl/sparse/algebra/all, secondary deterministic evidence; no gate

stage_B_end_to_end.runs_only_if: stage A gate clears for 'all' or for a single cut; then the T20 harness (run_t20.sh pattern, 3 pinned cores, KIC_RANK_THREADS=3, same base/target/seed 7) with arms C (ctl) and T (the clearing configuration), order C1 T1 C2, A/A = C1/C2, reusing the T20 matched rho draws (same host, same rho binary; disclosed) and a fresh frozen protocol file before timing
stage_B_end_to_end.otherwise: not run; the negative scan result is the T21 result

inadmissible: changing arms, rounds, gate or switches after timing
dropping a round for being slow
reporting a scan ratio as an end-to-end speedup
report: observation; no S claim (counted S identical by construction); wall time secondary
